properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured): closure_report cannot compute an owner's "design done" criterion, because its traceability leg is the DELIVERY predicate (satisfied + realized + a PASSING check). So a finished design with nothing built reads 0/7. Seams and decisions read null (nothing to run on), not closed. The budgets leg never reads `basis`, so "build done needs measured numbers" cannot be said either. The idea it was built from said "a design that closes can be built", and the build took "every leg a computation that already exists"
